svg.title: bifolding double swing preview
svg.desc: 3000 mm opening · 1000 mm high · composite boards · Black satin. Figma CAD silhouette — no baked millimetres on the drawing. Bifold double: 2 leaves × 2 panels (50/50). Fold stilts mid-leaf. Stack pack outside posts. Leaf pair fills clear opening between posts (CA-09/10).
